clock_basis.description: handshake: device offset measured; relay_assumed: relayed device clock assumed in sync with its relay; server: produced by the server; none: no offset estimate (uncorrected).
clock_basis.title: Clock Basis

clock_uncertainty_ms.description: Half round-trip of the best handshake sample, plus margin.
clock_uncertainty_ms.title: Clock Uncertainty Ms

corrected_captured_at.description: captured_at mapped to the server clock (event time).
corrected_captured_at.title: Corrected Captured At

out_of_order.description: Arrived after a later sequence number from the same source.
out_of_order.title: Out Of Order

late.description: Older than the staleness limit for its type when it arrived.
late.title: Late
